description: An oscillator whose single cycle is drawn by six knobs: each sets the height of one point, and the waveform runs through them.

params.text: How much the FQ jack moves the pitch. With nothing patched into FQ this knob is a fine tune instead.
Height of the first point in the cycle.
Height of the second point in the cycle.
Height of the third point in the cycle.
Height of the fourth point in the cycle.
Height of the fifth point in the cycle.
Height of the sixth point in the cycle.
Sets the pitch range the FQ knob covers: up is the highest, middle is the range meant for one-volt-per-octave control, down is the lowest.

inputs.text: Sets the pitch at one volt per octave.
Moves the pitch, by as much as the MOD knob allows.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
